/--
Type class for the `singleton` operation.
Used to implement the `{ a, b, c }` syntax.
-/
class Singleton (α : outParam <| Type u) (β : Type v) where
  /-- `singleton x` is a collection with the single element `x` (notation: `{x}`). -/
  singleton : α → β
